description: Held-out accuracy of a linear probe (Fisher direction) on captured actor-MLP layer-3 (256-d) activations, separating the working checkpoint's hidden states from a failing/early checkpoint's, per ManiSkill PPO policy. Real measured values from a GPU capture+probe run on athena. Activations captured via taco_demo/scripts/patch_ppo_capture.py forward hooks; probe fit by taco_demo/scripts/probe_fit.py; runner taco_demo/scripts/probe_run.sh.
